وَقَّادٌ Shining, or shining brightly; (L, K;) applied to a star. (L.) ―
-b2- وَقَّادٌ (L, K) and ↓ مُتَوَقِّدٌ (L) (tropical:) A heart, or mind. quickly excited with ardour, or eagerness, in liveliness and acuteness or penetration. (L, K.) ―
-b3- Also, both words, (tropical:) A man (L) clever, ingenious, acute, sharp, or penetrating. (L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
